name: Trip to China
summary:
Trip to China takes you to the places people dream of seeing, in full 360° photographs you can look around in.

57 journeys, 680 stops. Walk the Great Wall at Badaling as the sun goes down, cross the courtyards of the Forbidden City, look up at the Potala Palace in Lhasa, drift past the karst peaks of Guilin, stand under the three sacred snow mountains of Yading, and watch the Bund light up at night. Journeys cover cities, mountains, temples, grottoes, gardens, deserts and coasts, from Harbin's ice festival
